hostname ix-l01
!
ip route default 203.0.113.10
!
ip access-list sec-sample-ra permit ip src any dest any
!
ike nat-traversal
!
ike proposal ike-prop-sample-ra encryption aes-256 hash sha2-256 group 2048-bit
ike policy ike-sample-ra peer any key dummy-psk-sample-ra ike-prop-sample-ra
!
ipsec autokey-proposal ipsec-prop-sample-ra esp-aes-256 esp-sha
ipsec dynamic-map ipsec-sample-ra sec-sample-ra ipsec-prop-sample-ra
!
url-list lac-sample permit domain *example.com
!
ppp profile lns-sample
  authentication request chap
  authentication password example-user dummy-l2tp-user-secret-1
  authentication password sample-user dummy-l2tp-user-secret-2
  lcp pfc
  lcp acfc
  ipcp ip-compression
  ipcp provide-static-ip-address example-user 192.0.2.130
  ipcp provide-ip-address range 192.0.2.131 192.0.2.190
  ipcp provide-remote-dns 192.0.2.53 192.0.2.54
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample-wan
  ip address 203.0.113.9/30
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2.0
  description sample-access
  ip address 198.51.100.129/25
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2.1
  pppoe l2tp interface Tunnel2.0 url-list lac-sample
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet2.0
  no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0.0
  ip address 192.0.2.129/25
!
interface Tunnel0.0
  ppp binding lns-sample
  tunnel mode l2tp-lns ipsec
  ip unnumbered Loopback0.0
  ipsec policy transport ipsec-sample-ra
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel2.0
  l2tp session idle-time 120
  l2tp password plain dummy-l2tp-secret-c
  tunnel mode l2tp-lac ip
  tunnel destination 198.51.100.1
  no ip address
  no shutdown
